essence: Performing the full prior procedure enables effortless killing of the target.
Offering a tenth part with sesame seeds paralyzes the enemy host.
Fasting accompanies mantra repetition and sesame oblations.
The practitioner should long envision Rāmabhadra and the enemy Rāvaṇa directly.
The vision includes Sugrīva, Nārada, and other deities as attendants.
